basic_info.description: Top Floor Condo with views of Golden Gate Park and Sutro Tower.  Recently renovated, this spacious 3 bedroom and 2 bath Condo offers great natural light with skylights throughout and bay windows.  Open floor plan creates a seamless flow between kitchen, dining and living room that is equipped with a cozy wood-burning fireplace.  Finishes include Hansgrohe hardware, custom maple cabinets and stainless steel appliances along with a dedicated in-unit laundry room.  Located at the doorstep of Golden Gate Park boasting and just steps from the vibrant restaurants and shops of Irving Street, with easy access to 19th Ave for commuting to South Bay on I-280 and close proximity to Ocean Beach, this home offers both urban convenience and natural beauty in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. (pictures are from lower unit with similar floorplan)
